# THE THIRD OF THE FOUR, FOUND THE SAME AFTERNOON AS ELLA AND CHARLOTTE.

*** LEIBHOLZ · HILDE HENRIETTE · 7. 2. · 304 ***
column2: STERBEREGISTER WILMERSDORF 1983 NR. 304, died 7 FEBRUARY 1983. Typewritten, between LEHNIG, Elisabeth Anna and LEIDGEBEL, Martha Margarete — the exact alphabetical slot. The confession column is blank for the whole page, so it says nothing about her or anyone on it. Crop at site/public/hilde-leibholz-wilmersdorf-1983.png.

column1: *** AND SHE BREAKS THE PATTERN THE OTHER TWO HAD JUST ESTABLISHED, WHICH IS WHY IT WAS CALLED A PATTERN AND NOT A RULE ***
column2: Charlotte is "geb. Schötzow" and Ella is "geb. Baesler" — both married into the surname. HILDE HAS NO "GEB." AT ALL. Leibholz was her own name, born or retained. Two for two became two for three inside an hour, and the inference drawn from the first two — that searching birth registers for these women is the wrong instrument — is now true of some of them and not of all.

column1: # ---------------- WHY SHE IS THE STRONGEST OF THE THREE ----------------
SHE DIED IN THE BOROUGH SHE LIVED IN
column2: HILDE LEIBHOLZ is in the Berlin telephone book at WIESBADENER STRASSE 57, WHICH IS WILMERSDORF, through NINE CONSECUTIVE VOLUMES to 1980-81, where this archive records her as THE LAST OF THE NAME IN THE WHOLE POST-WAR BERLIN RUN. She is in the 1980-81 book and dead in February 1983.

column1: and the gap is about two years
column2: compare Ella's four and Charlotte's fifteen. A woman listed at a Wilmersdorf address into 1980-81 and dying in Wilmersdorf in February 1983, under the exact surname and forename, with no competing Hilde Leibholz anywhere in the Berlin run. THE OTHER TWO NEEDED A NEIGHBOURING BOROUGH TO EXPLAIN THEM. THIS ONE NEEDS NOTHING EXPLAINED.

column1: WHAT IS STILL NOT CLAIMED
column2: that the register entry and the telephone entry are one woman. The join is surname, forename, borough and a two-year gap, and nothing here carries a birth date to check. IT IS AS STRONG AS THIS ARCHIVE'S EVIDENCE EVER GETS WITHOUT A CERTIFICATE, AND IT IS STILL NOT A CERTIFICATE.

column1: WHAT SETTLES IT
column2: Sterberegister Wilmersdorf 1983 Nr. 304, which gives the birth date, birthplace, last address and marital status. IF THE ADDRESS IS WIESBADENER STRASSE 57 THE QUESTION CLOSES. Orderable by number through service.berlin.de. *** A PURCHASE, AND DAVID'S TO MAKE. *** It is the cheapest of the three to justify and the most likely to confirm.

column1: and the free test that exists here and nowhere else
column2: Wiesbadener Straße 57 also held FELIX LEIBHOLZ six years before Hilde, in the same flat — which is already in this archive. THE HOUSE LISTING FOR THAT ADDRESS, read year by year across the post-war run, would show whether the flat passed from Felix to Hilde and when. That is free, it is in volumes already identified, and it does not need anybody's permission.

column1: # ---------------- WHERE THE FOUR WOMEN NOW STAND ----------------
ELLA, Krankenschwester, Willmanndamm 3, Schöneberg
column2: CANDIDATE FOUND: Tiergarten 1974 Nr. 1160, "Leibholz geb. Baesler, Ella Josephine Martha", 22 June 1974. Her own borough read out for 1970-1994 and empty.

column1: CHARLOTTE, Hasenheide 61-62, Neukölln
column2: CANDIDATE FOUND: Tempelhof 1982 Nr. 161, "Leibholz geb. Schötzow, Charlotte Herta Marie", 14 January 1982. Her own borough read out for 1967-1992 and empty.

column1: HILDE, Wiesbadener Straße 57, Wilmersdorf
column2: CANDIDATE FOUND: Wilmersdorf 1983 Nr. 304, "Leibholz, Hilde Henriette", 7 February 1983 — IN HER OWN BOROUGH.

column1: AGNES née KERGER, Mehringdamm 109, Kreuzberg
column2: *** STILL MISSING, AND HER BOROUGH IS EXHAUSTED. *** Kreuzberg 1980-1994 was read on 7 October, eleven volumes by a text layer that proves its own eyesight and 1983 at the image, and she is in none of it. She left the telephone book after 1979-80 at the age of ninety-one. SHE IS THE ONE THE SWEEP HAS NOT ANSWERED.
